safetyAssessment.credentials: No credential access by reviewer. Guarded launcher extracts only the approved variable, verifies its digest, passes it via child environment, and never prints it or places it in argv. Runner declaration precedes endpoint access/network enablement.
safetyAssessment.bounds: One explicit rank8/B item, unchanged frozen conditional TS runtime and normal budgets. Existing binary-internal bounded wire retries remain disclosed; no outer attempt retry or warmup. Soft/hard stops target the owned leader/group only, with interrupted/residual receipt inconclusive.
safetyAssessment.writeOnceAndDrain: Exclusive log/receipt creation and nonexisting output directory prevent automatic rerun/overwrite. Runner joins physical drain before one results flush. All completed outputs and immutable inputs must still be checked afterward.
safetyAssessment.heldTest: Loopback-only single pinned request with withheld response; checks begin before source response, absent end/terminal/result after owned-child termination, numeric identity and no endpoint in stderr. Execution evidence belongs to main; reviewer only inspected and parsed this test.
safetyAssessment.interpretation: Diagnostic evidence only. Missing terminal/end records or truncation stay censored/unknown, not zero. A successful launcher exit cannot establish full-route, Solver or live improvement.
